0.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_000
0.description: You will accompany us, then? My thanks!

1.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_001
1.description: Our task is simple─we shall take Blitzen on a tour of Gridania and delight the children we meet with his marvelous illusions.

2.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_002
2.description: While little helpers will be distributing presents of a more tangible nature, I believe that Blitzen's glamour will perfectly set the tone for such gift-giving.

3.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_003
3.description: Being a visitor to this city, however, I am not certain where to seek out children. May I trust you to guide us to them?

4.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_004
4.description: Marvelous! Without further ado, then, where shall we head first?

12.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_005
12.description: Very well. Let us go and spread some Starlight cheer!

13.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDA00800_100_010
13.description: Wow, a real reindeer! I've only ever read about them before!

14.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_110_010
14.description: Go on, Blitzen! Show us your spectacular glamour!

16.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_BEATINE_000_010
16.description: Indeed─much like the scent of freshly hewn cedar! Happy Starlight, youngling. We, the saint's little helpers, have come bearing gifts one can touch as well as see.

19.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_BEATINE_000_013
19.description: It is a lumber set, child. Comprised of the finest selection of timber the forest has to share. You have your soft-grained maple, some supple ash, a stern oak... Cannot you hear the symphony?

21.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_FUFUCHA_000_015
21.description: Those are building blocks, my dear. Made especially for you by the Carpenters' Guild!

22.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDA00800_000_016
22.description: Oh! I love blocks! Thank you, little helpers!

23.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_BEATINE_000_017
23.description: Curious that he should appreciate “blocks” over fine cross-sections of lumber. Puzzling indeed...

25.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_FUFUCHA_000_019
25.description: Why, hello, adventurer! Are you this reindeer's friend?

26.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_FUFUCHA_000_020
26.description: As you can see, the Botanists' and Carpenters' Guilds are working together for this year's celebration, with the guildmasters volunteering to be little helpers.

27.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_FUFUCHA_000_021
27.description: Our gifts are a joint effort─Beatin's people at the Carpenters' Guild made some beautiful blocks out of the wood my botanists gathered while tending the forest.

28.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_FUFUCHA_000_023
28.description: I hope these toys sow the seeds of inspiration within the hearts of our younglings, that they might grow up embracing nature. But enough of my vegetation metaphors─we have presents to distribute!

30.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_BEATINE_000_025
30.description: Indeed. And let us use that “blocks” jest from earlier─it seemed rather effective...

31.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDB00800_100_030
31.description: Oh, hello! This is my first time meeting a reindeer─is he friendly?

32.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_110_030
32.description: Go on, Blitzen! Show us your spectacular glamour!

34.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_GEVA_000_030
34.description: Happy Starlight, my dear. I have a gift for you from the saint. Perhaps not as sensational as that reindeer's trick, but these will last longer.

35.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDB00800_000_031
35.description: <gasp> Leather accessories! I love them! Thank you so much, little helper!

37.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_GEVA_000_033
37.description: ...I trust you are fulfilling your Starlight duties with the diligence expected of you?

38.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_GEVA_000_034
38.description: Another Starlight volunteer, I take it?

39.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_GEVA_000_035
39.description: I too have volunteered my services this year. I thought it only right, seeing how much my own little ones delight in the season.

40.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_GEVA_000_036
40.description: 'Tis remarkable how a child's smile can warm the heart. An infectious joy if there ever was one.

41.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_GEVA_000_038
41.description: Anyway, I must be off. Enjoy the rest of the festivities.

42.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDC00800_100_040
42.description: Wow! Reindeer are massive! Look at him! He's massive!

43.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_110_040
43.description: Go on, Blitzen! Show us your spectacular glamour!

45.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_MIOUNNE_000_040
45.description: (-???-)Happy Starlight, my child! This little helper has arrived with a very special gift.

46.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDC00800_000_041
46.description: Cookies!? My favorite! Thank you, little helper! I'm going to go and share them with my friends!

47.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_MIOUNNE_000_042
47.description: Well, if it isn't <hex:020925E947FF07022903EB0203FF11022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203FF07022903EB020303>! Lending your assistance to the Starlight Celebration?

48.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_MIOUNNE_000_043
48.description: As you can see, the Carline Canopy is also participating in the festivities this year.

49.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_MIOUNNE_000_044
49.description: Our establishment has adopted the Starlight spirit, with a special children's menu in addition to festive decorations. 'Tis the season, after all!

50.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_MIOUNNE_000_045
50.description: Now, while I would love to stay and chat, I must be off─these cookies won't deliver themselves! I look forward to seeing you again at the Canopy.

51.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDD00800_100_050
51.description: Why, good <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>, Mister Reindeer! You have quite an adorable face and snuffly nose at that!

52.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_110_050
52.description: Go on, Blitzen! Show us your spectacular glamour!

53.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDD00800_120_050
53.description: What a marvelous spectacle! You're truly amazing, Mister Reindeer!

54.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_050
54.description: (-???-)Forgive me for interrupting your delight, sweet child, but this little helper comes bearing a gift from the north.

55.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDD00800_000_051
55.description: An Ishgardian coat? Oh, how lovely and warm! I shall treasure it, little helper! Thank you with all my heart!

56.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_052
56.description: What a pleasant surprise to meet you here, my friend. You are lending your capable hand to the observances, I take it?

57.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_053
57.description: As a citizen of Starlight's birthplace, I felt compelled to volunteer my services in some way, however small. And thus I seem to have become a little helper.

58.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_054
58.description: While 'twas an audience with the Elder Seedseer that called me here initially, I am glad for the opportunity to bear witness to the bright smiles of Gridania's children.

59.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_055
59.description: Yes, I have always been quite fond of this season myself. Though I must confess that as colors go, I am somewhat partial to blue...

60.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_056
60.description: ...Hm? Why is it that I feel we have spoken of this before? Curious...

61.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_AYMERIC_000_057
61.description: Ah, but I mustn't dally─many gifts still want for delivery. Till we meet again!

62.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDE00800_100_060
62.description: I had no idea reindeer were so big...

63.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_110_060
63.description: Go on, Blitzen! Show us your spectacular glamour!

65.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_EMMANELLAIN_000_060
65.description: Starlight greetings, you adorable little moppet! I am one of the saint's little helpers, and I have a <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> sparkling present for you! Here you go!

66.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDE00800_000_061
66.description: A lovely doll...with such pretty eyes. Thank you, little helper.

67.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_SICARD_000_062
67.description: (-???-)Hah, is that what passes as a gift for you lace-wearers!?

69.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_SICARD_000_064
69.description: Deliverin' <hex:021A020203>proper<hex:021A020103> presents, what else? Here's yours, little one. Enjoy it, now!

70.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDE00800_000_065
70.description: A little frypan...with such adorable forks and spoons. Thank you, little helper.

71.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_SICARD_000_066
71.description: Heh! See? A present that represents the glory and traditions of Limsa Lominsa's peerless culinary history! More thoughtful by far than some half-baked doll from some half-baked noble!

74.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_EMMANELLAIN_000_071
74.description: I will not stoop to your level!

75.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_CHILDE00800_000_072
75.description: I'll enjoy playing house with the lovely doll and adorable silverware. Thank you, little helpers!

80.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_080
80.description: Well, that went splendidly, wouldn't you say? The little helpers appearing when they did only added to the children's enjoyment. And last but not least, Blitzen played his part to perfection.

81.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022OMAKE_00800_LAURENSSEN_000_081
81.description: We shall take a well-earned rest, but we would welcome your assistance again should you feel like going on another tour.
